subject: Evening hosting & catering plan for Horizon Health exec workshop (June 12)
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@horizonhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Procurement <procure@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catering + evening hosting for Jun 12 workshop

Hi Laura / Marissa —

Thanks again for running the executive workshop on June 12. A quick ask from my side: our execs would like you to host a private dinner for the visiting Horizon execs + project team the evening of June 12 (start ~6:30pm; wrap by 9:00pm). We expect ~22 attendees (11 Horizon, 11 Redwood) but I’ll confirm final headcount by June 6.

Two constraints from procurement:
- Budget target is $120–$150 per person total (food + tax + service).
- We need vegetarian + gluten-free options (I’ll send dietary details once confirmed).

I attached a rough menu from our preferred caterer (menu_options.xlsx). We don’t need a formal venue if Redwood can host somewhere near the hotel — private room, plated service preferred, no open bar (company policy). If you can propose 2 options (one on-site at hotel, one nearby restaurant with private dining) and confirm payment/invoicing flow, that would be great.

Also flagging procurement on cc for contract/invoice steps.

Thanks —
Sophie
Sophie Martin
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Horizon Health
[attachment: menu_options.xlsx]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Horizon Health Procurement <procure@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catering + evening hosting for Jun 12 workshop

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the details. We can absolutely take the lead on hosting. Proposed plan and asks below: 

1) Venue options (we’ll confirm availability and hold deposits):
   - The Gilded Fork (private dining room, 20–30 pax capacity, 3-course plated menu) — vendor quoted $135/person incl. tax & service.
   - Harbor Room at The Meridian Hotel (in-hotel private dining — easier for AV/transport) — estimated $150/person + service; requires $500 deposit.
   - Redwood conference suite (onsite at our office) with plated catering from Gilded Fork — this avoids hotel fees but needs drinks & quieter AV setup.

2) AV / timing / logistics:
   - We will reserve 6:00pm–9:30pm to allow for pre-event setup and drop-off.
   - Please confirm whether Horizon will require an AV feed from the workshop (video/slide playback) at the dinner. If yes, we’ll include a basic laptop + projector rental (~$200).

3) Budget & payment flow:
   - We can target $140/person to hit mid-range.
   - Redwood can cover the deposit and invoice Horizon post-event. Dev, can you confirm accounting code and PO process?

4) Headcount & dietaries:
   - Please confirm final headcount by EOD June 6 and provide a dietary restriction spreadsheet.

I’m attaching a draft venue contract for the Gilded Fork with standard redlines from our legal team (venue_contract_draft.pdf). Marissa — want to coordinate on gift bags and name cards?

Next steps: I’ll hold the Gilded Fork tentatively for 48 hours and request a formal menu selection once we confirm headcount.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Lead — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[attachment: venue_contract_draft.pdf]

Subject: Re: Catering + evening hosting for Jun 12 workshop

Laura — thanks, Gilded Fork sounds good to me as a primary. A couple quick items I’ll own:
- Gift bags: small leather portfolio + branded pen for visiting execs (qty 11). Budget $40/pack.
- Place cards and seating: I’ll make a simple layout and share with Sophie once headcount confirmed.
- Vendor contact: I’ve worked with Gilded Fork events manager (Abe Torres) before — I’ll re-introduce and push for a plated menu with a separate GF/veg entree.

Forwarding Abe’s last estimate for your reference.

Laura / Marissa —

Confirming final headcount: 21 attendees (10 Horizon, 11 Redwood). Dietary restrictions below:
- Anna Ruiz (Horizon) — vegetarian
- Mark Chen (Horizon) — gluten-free
- Two others — pescatarian

We’re happy with Gilded Fork as the venue. Please proceed with the plated menu at the $135/person option and advise if the GF/veg choices need a small upcharge. We will accept standard invoice terms (Net 30) to Horizon.

One last request: could Redwood coordinate simple name badges and a brief welcome note at each place setting (one paragraph)? If you can send a draft of the welcome note, Sophie will route to her execs for a quick OK.

Thanks so much — looking forward to it.

Best,
Sophie
